dedupe_keys.name: u shift impt data data treatment processing steps and methodological report for multimodal transport poverty index

description: The U-Shift Lab publishes IMPT-data, processed measures and documented calculation steps for a multimodal transport-poverty index in the Lisbon Metropolitan Area. Zenodo lists a public GPL-3.0 release with municipality, parish and grid-level CSV and GeoJSON files. The index combines access, mobility, affordability and safety across cars, public transport, cycling and walking. The linked R repository and online methods report explain how the data were prepared. A modeller can use the mapped indicators to locate groups underserved by a transport scenario or compare changes in network access. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these processed Lisbon indicators; the linked IMPT web viewer is a separate presentation tool. A limitation is that the index embeds choices about indicators and aggregation, so it cannot by itself predict travel behaviour after a new service or road. Some GeoJSON files are large and none was downloaded; field definitions and scores were not independently recalculated.
